title: Rabbi Chelbo bar Chanan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 7:1 he speaks in Rav’s name, and Rav Sheshet objects to him. Hyman suggests that here too the reading should be “Rabbi Chelbo, Rav Chuna in the name of Rav.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 7:1 paragraph reads Rabbi Chelbo [Rav] Chanan in Rav’s name. Hyman instead proposes separating Rabbi Chelbo and Rav Chuna; his proposed parsing is preserved as tentative, not made into an admitted genealogy.

The source’s tentative proposed reading is Hyman’s. The digital text’s bracketed Rav and its Chanan are preserved as a separate witness reading, without silently replacing Chanan by Chuna or creating a father-son identification.
